Section  7  of  the  principal  enactment  is  hereby
by  the  repeal  of  paragraph  (a)  of  subsection  (2)
thereof and the substitution therefor of the following
paragraph:—

“(a)
to arrange for the conduct of a Lottery by
the  National  Lotteries  Board  with  the
inclusion  of  the  expression  “Shrama
Vasana” on the face of each such lottery
ticket;”  and
by the addition immediately after paragraph (i) of
subsection  (2)  of  that  section  of  the  following
paragraph:—

“(ia)
to  promote  and  propagate  the  lotteries

and”.
Section  13  of  the  principal  enactment  is  hereby
by  the  repeal  of  subsection  (2)    thereof  and  the
substitution therefor of the following subsection:—
“(2)  Every  such  Lottery  shall  have  the
expression “Shrama Vasana” on the face of each
Lottery  ticket  and  shall  be  conducted  in  such
manner as may  be agreed between the Fund and
the Lotteries Board.”; and
